mapper.select: SELECT v.`id`, v.`shop_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`description`, v.`image`, v.`price`, v.`original_price`, v.`type`, sp.`stock` , sp.begin_time , sp.end_time FROM tb_product v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_product sp ON v.id = sp.product_id WHERE v.shop_id = #{shopId} AND v.status = 1

SELECT v.`id`, v.`shop_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`description`, v.`image`, v.`price`, v.`original_price`, v.`type`, sp.`stock`, sp.begin_time, sp.end_time FROM tb_product v INNER JOIN tb_seckill_product sp ON v.id = sp.product_id WHERE v.type = 1 AND v.status = 1
